title: M6 actual gcd-dependent boundary fiber cardinality
scope: Every actual boundary has exactly2^deg gcd(a,b,M) preimages.

spec.name: M6.BoundaryFibers.nonzero_monic
queries: finite cardinality subtype equivalence fibers additive map
spec.guidance: A nonzero polynomial overZMod2 has nonzero leading coefficient; enumerate its two possible values to show leadingCoeff=1. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.BoundaryFibers.signature_nonzero
spec.statement: ∀ a b M : M6.BoundaryFibers.BP, M ≠ 0 → M6.Cyclic.signature a b M ≠ 0
queries: finite cardinality subtype equivalence fibers additive map
spec.guidance: signature divides M by accepted Cyclic.signature_divides; ifzero then zero divides nonzeroM contradiction. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.BoundaryFibers.boundary_add
spec.statement: ∀ (a b M : M6.BoundaryFibers.BP) (h k : AdjoinRoot M), M6.BoundaryFibers.boundary a b M (h+k) = M6.BoundaryFibers.boundary a b M h + M6.BoundaryFibers.boundary a b M k
queries: finite cardinality subtype equivalence fibers additive map
spec.guidance: Unfold boundary; Prod.ext and mul_add. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.BoundaryFibers.kernel_iff
spec.statement: ∀ (a b M : M6.BoundaryFibers.BP) (h : AdjoinRoot M), M6.BoundaryFibers.boundary a b M h = (0,0) ↔ AdjoinRoot.mk M (M6.Cyclic.signature a b M) * h = 0
queries: finite cardinality subtype equivalence fibers additive map
spec.guidance: Represent h using AdjoinRoot.induction_on. map_mul and mk_eq_zero reduce both sides to accepted Cyclic.kernel_divisibility. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.BoundaryFibers.annihilator_general
spec.statement: ∀ (F M : M6.BoundaryFibers.BP), F.Monic → F ∣ M → M ≠ 0 → Nat.card {h : AdjoinRoot M // AdjoinRoot.mk M F * h = 0} = 2^F.natDegree
queries: finite cardinality subtype equivalence fibers additive map
spec.guidance: Write M=F*K using divisibility, deduce K≠0, exact KernelFibers.annihilator_card with subtype definition unfolded. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.BoundaryFibers.kernel_card
spec.statement: ∀ a b M : M6.BoundaryFibers.BP, M ≠ 0 → Nat.card {h : AdjoinRoot M // M6.BoundaryFibers.boundary a b M h = (0,0)} = 2^(M6.Cyclic.signature a b M).natDegree
queries: finite cardinality subtype equivalence fibers additive map
spec.guidance: Subtype equivalence via kernel_iff, annihilator_general with signature monic and dividesM. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.BoundaryFibers.fiber_card
spec.statement: ∀ (a b M : M6.BoundaryFibers.BP), M ≠ 0 → ∀ h₀ : AdjoinRoot M, Nat.card {h : AdjoinRoot M // M6.BoundaryFibers.boundary a b M h = M6.BoundaryFibers.boundary a b M h₀} = 2^(M6.Cyclic.signature a b M).natDegree
queries: finite cardinality subtype equivalence fibers additive map
spec.guidance: Construct bijection kernel→fiber by h↦h+h₀, inverse h↦h-h₀, using boundary_add and linear multiplication. Then Nat.card_congr and kernel_card. General additive group proof works without characteristic2 shortcuts. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
